name: Quilty
description:
Quilty is a diagnostic screenplay analysis platform. This connector lets Claude read the completed analyses you already own, so you can talk through coverage, Quilty Score, and specific scenes without leaving the chat.

What Claude can do
• List your completed analyses (title, year, score)
• Open an analysis manifest (section index and sizes, not the full report)
• Fetch one analysis section at a time
• Return the Quilty Score with confidence range and pillar breakdown
• Read screenplay metadata (title with year, page count, genre, content type)
• Semantically search scenes in your uploaded screenplay

All tools are read-only. The connector cannot upload scripts, start analyses, change settings, or spend credits. Claude only sees analyses on the Quilty account you sign in with.

Scores are diagnostic assessments of the uploaded text, not predictions of box office or commercial outcome.

Connect with your Quilty login (OAuth). You need a Quilty account and at least one completed analysis. Setup: https://quilty.app/docs/claude-connector

_published_faq.name: How do I add Quilty to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Quilty to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://quilty.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Quilty MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quilty provides these MCP tools: get_analysis_manifest, get_analysis_section, get_quilty_score, get_screenplay_metadata, list_analyses, and search_screenplay.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Quilty?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Quilty in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.
Quilty requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Quilty is developed by Quilty. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
